name: task_evidence_read
description: Read evidence for one task. source=progress (default) returns its live phase/checkpoint snapshot. source=delivered is read-only: with agent-team optimizations enabled, defaults to a summary of at most 2 KiB including payload preview, verification availability, and advisory assessment; otherwise defaults to raw. Full persisted payload: task_evidence_read(source="delivered", view="raw", exact task_id), omitting fields/max_chars/cursor; fields selects metadata and cursor/max_chars page it. Explicit parameters work regardless of the optimization switch. Top-level verification is normalized and assessment is runtime-derived advisory requiring parent review; body-authored assessment values remain unverified worker content in payload/output; limits remain 8 KiB and 16 checks. Reading never collects or integrates. Use task_audit for recorded IDs.

task_id.description: Exact task_id returned by task_spawn or listed by task_audit. Delivered lookup preserves the ID verbatim.

source.description: progress preserves the existing live snapshot behavior; delivered performs a read-only lookup of a previously delivered result.

fields.description: Select top-level evidence fields, including verification and assessment when available. Unavailable names list available fields. With pagination, payload is serialized selected JSON; repeat identical fields for continuation. Explicit selection works with optimizations disabled.

max_chars.description: Limit raw payload or serialized selected JSON per page in Unicode scalar values. Metadata is outside this limit; verification/assessment remain visible. Returns cursor, shown_chars, total_chars, truncated, next_cursor, and a recovery hint. 0 returns metadata and an empty payload; increase max_chars to advance. Explicit limits work with optimizations disabled.

view.description: Delivered view: summary returns at most 2 KiB with preview and metadata discovery; raw returns the full original envelope when fields, max_chars, and cursor are omitted. Default is summary with agent-team optimizations enabled, raw otherwise. Projection parameters imply raw; explicit summary cannot be combined with them. Progress supports raw only.

cursor.description: Raw page start as a Unicode scalar offset, default 0. Pass next_cursor and identical fields to continue. Without max_chars, a cursor requests a 2048-character page. Cursor equal to total_chars returns an empty complete page; larger offsets error. Full evidence: task_evidence_read(source="delivered", view="raw", exact task_id), omitting fields/max_chars/cursor.
